items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: It's got Bill Matthews' picture on drums with you.

ctx.x: He's a good band in the new one.

Let me find this picture if I can. There's a picture of your tuxedo band about 1925, it says. This is in Jazz, New Orleans, 1885-1957 by S.B. Charters. It's got Bill Matthews' picture on drums with you.
